labs.title: Vaccines • Immunization • Preventive Medicine Intelligence Lab
labs.eyebrow: INDIA UIP • LIFE-COURSE IMMUNIZATION • CATCH-UP • PREGNANCY • HIGH-RISK • TRAVEL • PEP • VACCINE SAFETY
labs.subtitle: Research-oriented immunization workspace combining India programme context with WHO life-course/catch-up guidance, high-risk vaccination, travel/post-exposure prevention and vaccine-safety gates.
labs.scientific_boundary: Research/learning CDS only — not an automatic vaccination order-set. Vaccine eligibility, age, product, route, dose volume, interval, catch-up logic, pregnancy, immunocompromise, prior doses, exposure category, travel destination, outbreak policy and national programme can change. Use India National Immunization Schedule/U-WIN for UIP delivery and current WHO/national/product guidance for other indications. Do not infer that every globally listed vaccine is routinely recommended or available in India. Live vaccines, passive immunoglobulins, rabies PEP, pregnancy vaccination and immunocompromised patients require explicit verification. Cold-chain integrity and AEFI readiness are mandatory operational safeguards.

classification_notes.India programme first: Use U-WIN/National Immunization Schedule as the primary public-programme reference in India; private/adult/travel recommendations must be clearly distinguished.
classification_notes.Catch-up principle: Interrupted/delayed series should be managed using current catch-up guidance; do not automatically restart a series because an interval was prolonged.
classification_notes.Live-vaccine gate: Pregnancy and significant immunocompromise can change eligibility for many live vaccines; verify the exact product and current guidance.
classification_notes.Post-exposure gate: Rabies, tetanus, hepatitis B and varicella post-exposure prevention depends on exposure type, prior immunization and sometimes passive immunization; these are protocol-driven decisions.
classification_notes.Programme versus individual: WHO summary tables support policy decisions and global life-course planning; local/national schedules determine what is actually recommended and delivered.
classification_notes.Operational safety: Correct storage/cold chain, route, preparation, observation, anaphylaxis preparedness and AEFI reporting are part of safe vaccination, not optional add-ons.

classes.name: BCG vaccine
classes.mechanism: Live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis induces cellular immunity
classes.role_note: Programme vaccine used for prevention of severe forms of childhood tuberculosis; timing and technique are programme specific.

classes.name: Hepatitis B vaccine
classes.mechanism: Recombinant HBsAg induces anti-HBs immunity
classes.role_note: Pre-exposure and routine immunization against hepatitis B; birth-dose and later schedules are programme/history dependent.

classes.name: Polio vaccines
classes.mechanism: Mucosal live-attenuated or systemic inactivated poliovirus immunity
classes.role_note: Polio prevention using programme-specific OPV/IPV combinations.

classes.name: Diphtheria • Tetanus • Pertussis-containing vaccines
classes.mechanism: Toxoid plus pertussis antigen immunity
classes.target: Diphtheria toxin, tetanus toxin, Bordetella pertussis
classes.role_note: Primary-series and booster protection against diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis; combination products vary.

classes.name: Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate vaccine
classes.mechanism: Conjugate antigen induces T-cell-dependent immunity
classes.role_note: Prevention of invasive Hib disease, usually delivered in combination schedules.

classes.name: Rotavirus vaccines
classes.mechanism: Live oral vaccine induces intestinal immunity
classes.role_note: Infant gastroenteritis prevention with strict age/window and product-specific schedule considerations.

classes.name: Pneumococcal vaccines
classes.mechanism: Conjugate or polysaccharide capsular-antigen immunity
classes.role_note: Age- and risk-based pneumococcal prevention; product valency and sequencing vary by programme.

classes.name: Measles • Rubella / MMR vaccines
classes.mechanism: Live attenuated viral immunity
classes.role_note: Routine and catch-up prevention of measles/rubella; MMR adds mumps protection.

classes.name: Japanese encephalitis vaccines
classes.mechanism: Live attenuated or inactivated JE viral antigen immunity
classes.role_note: Programme/endemic-area and travel-related JE prevention.

classes.name: Td / Tdap vaccines
classes.mechanism: Diphtheria and tetanus toxoids ± acellular pertussis antigens
classes.role_note: Adolescent/adult boosters, pregnancy and wound-management vaccination depending schedule/history.

classes.name: Human papillomavirus vaccines
classes.mechanism: Virus-like particle vaccines induce neutralizing antibodies
classes.role_note: Primary prevention of HPV-related cancers; schedule depends age, immune status and national programme.

classes.name: Influenza vaccines
classes.mechanism: Seasonal strain-specific humoral immunity
classes.role_note: Seasonal influenza prevention using age/product-appropriate vaccine.

classes.name: COVID-19 vaccines
classes.mechanism: Platform-specific induction of immunity to SARS-CoV-2 antigens
classes.role_note: Risk- and programme-based COVID-19 vaccination; recommendations evolve with circulating variants and national policy.

classes.name: Varicella vaccine
classes.mechanism: Live attenuated varicella-zoster virus immunity
classes.role_note: Prevention of primary varicella in susceptible eligible people.

classes.name: Recombinant zoster vaccine
classes.mechanism: Recombinant VZV glycoprotein/adjuvanted immunity
classes.role_note: Prevention of herpes zoster and complications in age/risk groups where recommended.

classes.name: Hepatitis A vaccines
classes.mechanism: Active immunity to hepatitis A virus
classes.role_note: Hepatitis A prevention for routine/private, risk-based or travel indications depending setting.

classes.name: Meningococcal ACWY conjugate vaccines
classes.mechanism: Conjugate capsular-antigen immunity
classes.role_note: Risk-, travel-, outbreak- and schedule-based meningococcal ACWY prevention.

classes.name: Meningococcal B vaccines
classes.mechanism: Protein-based immunity to meningococcal B antigens
classes.role_note: Risk- and country-specific meningococcal B prevention.

classes.name: Typhoid vaccines
classes.mechanism: Capsular conjugate, polysaccharide or live oral immunity
classes.role_note: Typhoid prevention using product- and age-specific strategies; not a substitute for safe water/food.

classes.name: Rabies vaccines — PrEP / PEP
classes.mechanism: Inactivated rabies virus vaccine induces neutralizing antibodies
classes.role_note: Rabies pre-exposure and post-exposure active immunization; PEP is time-critical and exposure-category/history dependent.

classes.name: Rabies passive immunization
classes.mechanism: Immediate neutralizing antibody around exposure site
classes.role_note: Passive component of PEP for indicated exposures in previously unvaccinated persons; must be infiltrated/administered per current protocol.

classes.name: Tetanus immune globulin
classes.mechanism: Passive antitoxin immunity
classes.role_note: Passive tetanus prophylaxis for selected wounds in patients with inadequate/unknown immunization, alongside active vaccination when indicated.

classes.name: RSV vaccines
classes.mechanism: Prefusion-F/protein-based active immunity
classes.role_note: Active RSV prevention in older adults and/or pregnancy depending product and national policy.

classes.name: RSV monoclonal-antibody prevention
classes.mechanism: Long-acting or periodic neutralizing antibody to RSV F protein
classes.role_note: Passive RSV prevention for infants/selected high-risk children where indicated.

classes.name: Mpox vaccine
classes.mechanism: Orthopoxvirus vaccine-induced cross-protective immunity
classes.role_note: Risk- and outbreak-based mpox vaccination; not universal routine immunization.

classes.name: Yellow fever vaccine
classes.mechanism: Live attenuated 17D-derived immunity
classes.role_note: Travel/endemic-area yellow fever prevention and international certificate requirements where applicable.

classes.name: Oral cholera vaccines
classes.mechanism: Oral killed whole-cell antigen induces intestinal immunity
classes.role_note: Public-health/travel cholera prevention in defined settings; sanitation and safe water remain essential.

classes.name: Dengue vaccines
classes.mechanism: Live/chimeric or attenuated tetravalent dengue immunity
classes.role_note: Dengue vaccination is product-, age-, serostatus- and country-policy specific; inappropriate use can be harmful.

classes.name: Malaria vaccines
classes.mechanism: Pre-erythrocytic Plasmodium falciparum circumsporozoite-protein immunity
classes.role_note: WHO-recommended malaria vaccines for children in malaria-endemic programme settings; not a travel substitute for chemoprophylaxis.

classes.name: Varicella-zoster immune globulin
classes.mechanism: Passive anti-VZV antibodies
classes.role_note: Post-exposure passive protection for selected susceptible high-risk people when vaccination is contraindicated/inadequate.

classes.name: Hepatitis B immune globulin
classes.mechanism: Passive anti-HBs antibodies
classes.role_note: Passive hepatitis B protection in selected perinatal/post-exposure scenarios together with active vaccine when indicated.
